overview.text: 你 means “you,” usually addressing one person. Its visible form combines 亻 and 尔, the simplified form of 爾, which was also used for “you/your.” The proposed sound role of 尔 in 你 remains disputed.

components.text: One analysis treats 亻 as the person category; its historical role in 你 remains unresolved.
尔 is proposed as a sound cue, but its role in 你 is not established.
